papers.title: OTel: Open Telco AI Datasets, Benchmarks, and Models

languages.quote: The current release is English-only and primarily text-centric.

description.text:
**OTel-LLM-12B-Safety** is a safety-tuned telecom language model full-parameter fine-tuned on OTel telecommunications data. It is part of the [OTel Family of Models](https://huggingface.co/collections/farbodtavakkoli/otel-llm), an open-source initiative to build reference AI resources for the global telecommunications sector.

The safety variants are auxiliary models trained to refuse when retrieved context is insufficient or off-topic.

output_type.quote: This model is intended for telecom RAG pipelines where the assistant should refuse to answer when retrieved context is missing, irrelevant, or insufficient.

use_claim.quote: **OTel-LLM-12B-Safety** is a safety-tuned telecom language model full-parameter fine-tuned on OTel telecommunications data.

warning.quote: OTel models are domain-specific to telecommunications and should not be treated as general-purpose models.

serving.text_only_input_quote: The current release is English-only and primarily text-centric.
serving.notes: generation_config.json sets do_sample, top_k 64, and top_p 0.95. The card usage example sets max_new_tokens to 256. tokenizer_config.json has no chat_template key, use_default_system_prompt false, and model_max_length 1500. config.json text_config max_position_embeddings is 131072. config.json also has a Gemma 3 vision tower. The card usage example is a text prompt. No adapter_config.json, notebook, or training script is in the model repository. Quantized base during training is no: the card says Precision BF16 and full-parameter post-training. AdamW 8-bit is the optimizer, not a quantized base.

evaluation_reported.text: This model is an auxiliary safety-tuned variant trained for abstention behavior and is not part of the 30-model core baseline table. It should be evaluated with abstention-focused metrics for the target deployment, such as correct-abstention rate on insufficient-context examples and answer quality on sufficient-context examples. The paper names this checkpoint and does not print a score for it. Table 7 scores OTel-LLM-12B-IT, a different checkpoint.
